description: Publish an HTML site to BrewPage. Single-page: pass `entryContent`. Multi-page: pass `files` (array of `{path, content}`). Optional `entry` overrides default `index.html`.

entryContent.description: HTML content for a single-page site (entry file). Mutually exclusive with `files`.

files.description: Multi-file site: array of `{path, content}`. Mutually exclusive with `entryContent`.

namespace.description: Optional. Omit to keep the content PRIVATE/unlisted (reachable only by its link — not listed in the gallery and not indexed by search engines). Pass a custom namespace to group private content, or pass `public` ONLY when the user explicitly wants the page listed in the brewpage.app gallery and indexed by search engines.

ownerToken.description: Existing owner token to group this site under the same owner as previous content

password.description: Optional password to protect the site

ttlDays.description: Time to live in days (1-30, default: 15)

name: publish_site
